mechanism_narrative: A lower current federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the rate level directly influences risk-free rate assumptions in DCF models.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or the average 20-day return in the lowest 20% of FEDFUNDS observations is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth expectations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE rise >0.3pp) or the Rank IC between UNRATE change and returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly expansions in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% signal robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved earnings visibility.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 0.5% and RSAFS rises > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise >0.5% or the interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 indicates weakening economic momentum, triggering profit-taking and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as manufacturing slowdowns precede earnings revisions.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of INDPRO decline instances or the Rank IC between INDPRO and returns in that regime is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong residential construction activity, supporting consumer confidence and corporate capital expenditure, which elevates S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through sustained demand growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or the average 20-day return in the highest 20% of HOUST observations is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals accelerating inflation, prompting anticipated Federal Reserve tightening that compresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL rise >0.5pp) or the Rank IC between CPIAUCSL change and returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 100k and unemployment decline (UNRATE) below -0.2pp signal a tightening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profit margins, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 100k and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises >100k and UNRATE falls >0.2pp or the interaction term (PAYEMS * UNRATE) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained business investment.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between GDPC1 and 60-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or the average 60-day return in the highest 20% of GDPC1 observations is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).
